selection.bf16: Remove repeated row expansion and dimension/decoder dispatch from the existing recurrent alpha/beta projection path without changing precision or floating evaluation order.
selection.prefill: Preserve the existing private row-worker policy while sharing decoded packed blocks across prompt tokens; sequential rows were an explicit gap in the prior tiled source candidate.
selection.deferred: Existing prefix reuse, triangular GDN, fused recurrent copy/decay, optional ISA, accelerator and representation changes retain their independent qualification gates. No installed/default selection is inferred from source work counts.

implemented.bf16: Consume immutable BF16 weight bytes directly after full tensor-geometry admission. Preserve BF16 activation rounding, finite weight checks, rounded F32 products, the same Sum<f64> reduction/final F32 rounding, scalar dispatch diagnostics and empty-output failure. Reusable decoded-row storage is not populated or mutated.
implemented.bf16NominalWorkReduction: Across 48 recurrent layers with two 5120-by-48 BF16 matrices each, omit 94371840 bytes (90 MiB) of decoded F32 row writes and matching rereads per processed token. This is a source payload/work count, not measured memory traffic or latency.
implemented.prefill: Share the graph's existing persistent private Rayon pool, whether selected before or after tiled prefill. Workers borrow original weights/prepared activations and disjoint token-major output slices. Each packed block is decoded once across tile tokens; row arithmetic, backend selection, fourth PQ2 symbol, odd groups and PTQ1 native floating lanes remain unchanged. No transpose, expanded matrix or second pool is introduced.
implemented.cancellation: The original non-Send/non-Sync callback runs on the caller through in_place_scope, with nominal one-millisecond cooperative waits. Workers observe an atomic cancellation flag before each row. Tasks join before callback/numerical errors return; ordered error slots retain the earliest failing row chunk. Completion guards also signal on worker unwind. This is not a real-time cancellation guarantee.
implemented.resources: A fixed additional 16384-byte tiled scratch reservation covers up to sixteen task descriptors with thirty-two output slices, bounded errors/counters and synchronization. It remains charged for serial tiles so later worker-policy changes fit. Existing worker stacks and admission reserves remain independently charged.
implemented.controls: Independent decoded-row BF16 oracles and native captured BF16 results; packed scalar/NEON/worker parity; caller-thread non-Sync callback, joined cancellation, ordered failures and worker unwind; graph adapter/state/restore and policy changes. Exact names are mandatory in the owner-operated hosted efficiency gate.
